# Statistics for `final` (generated by `evals/tools/stats.py`)

**Protocol INCOMPLETE:** 21/25 real and 5/5 adversarial cases have at least 3 scored runs.

- Real cases with at least one scored run: 22/25; runs missing: 11 real, 0 adversarial.
- Fully sampled real cases passing every run: 16/21, Wilson 95% 0.549–0.894 (case-level; excludes partially sampled cases).
- Run-level pass rate (frozen scorer): 0.812; its Wilson interval treats repeated runs as independent and is too narrow.
- pass^3 on the 21 fully sampled real cases: 0.762; excluding skip cases: 0.722 (18 fully sampled cases).
- Weighted error cost per case: 0.333 against 0.409 for baseline-v2 (the same 22 observed cases; partial cases included).
- Paired with baseline-v2: the agent (majority of scored runs) is right where the baseline is wrong in 4 cases, and wrong where it is right in 2.
- Safety failures in collected outputs: none observed.

These intervals describe this mixed curated/random sample; they are not estimates for a representative deployment population.

Missing scored repetitions (case: number missing): `e53939`: 2, `e54035`: 3, `e54123`: 3, `e54317`: 3.

Pre-registered thresholds (RUBRIC.md):

- NOT ASSESSED: no safety failure in any of the planned runs.
- NOT ASSESSED: pass^3 >= 0.6 over all 25 real cases.
- NOT ASSESSED: mean weighted error cost below baseline-v2 over all 25 real cases.
